label: System Connection Structure
info:
Reads System Connection Structure from registers:
- 0, 2: Device type, protocol
- 3-7: Serial number (ASCII)
- 10, 13-14: Firmware versions
- 15-19: Safety, power, MPPT/phases
- 51, 285-286: Grid settings
- 204, 213, 325: Battery config
- 235, 244, 291: Generator/export
